items.claim: Close preset's 16px glyph drawn at 12px by the size rule
items.note: The size rule is the design: `measureButton` and the theme hook's docs both say 12px at sm, and `--wzl-button-icon-size` overrides it. So I removed the `size={16}` that never took effect rather than restoring the 16px glyph the old `CloseButton` drew. Restoring 16px would be a visual call.

items.claim: `domButton.measure` gives `md` while draw takes the `ControlSizeScope` size
items.note: This was a judgment call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: an unsized `domButton` draws at `md` on both sides, because measure can't read React context.
Also a judgment call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: measure throws on a link, since no token names the font around it.

items.claim: Lab "Export deltas" compares against the lab's own defaults, not what ships
Read-only toggle still shows hover, press and a pointer cursor
Pressed confirm button loses its accent body
Lab's held hover sample always shows confirm's hover
items.note: The solid, confirm and ghost hovers are now one custom property each, read by both the `:hover` rules and the lab.
